task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: Maya arrived early for her piano lesson at the community music studio. {{red:The studio is quiet before the afternoon classes.}} {{mask_1}}? She can hear a piano in the next room. {{red:Her teacher has a copy of the recital program.}} {{mask_2}}? The teacher shows it to Maya.

Maya opens her music folder. {{red:She has brought the sheet music.}} {{mask_3}}? She checks each page before the lesson begins. {{red:The first piece is difficult.}} {{mask_4}}? Maya has practiced it slowly all week. {{red:She does the scales before every lesson.}} {{mask_5}}? Her teacher asks her to warm up.

At the piano, {{red:Maya is sitting with a straight back.}} {{mask_6}}? Her teacher adjusts the bench slightly. {{red:The teacher has explained the new fingering.}} {{mask_7}}? Maya tries the passage again. {{red:She remembers the hand position.}} {{mask_8}}? She watches the teacher's demonstration carefully.

Maya begins the piece. {{red:She is keeping a steady tempo.}} {{mask_9}}? Her teacher listens from the other side of the room. {{red:The teacher is watching her hands.}} {{mask_10}}? After the first section, the teacher gives her a small suggestion. {{red:Maya does follow the beat.}} {{mask_11}}? She starts again and counts softly.

During a short break, they review the recital plan. {{red:Maya has chosen a piece for the recital.}} {{mask_12}}? She points to the title in her folder. {{red:The teacher has heard Maya play it before.}} {{mask_13}}? Maya says she performed it at home for her family. {{red:The family is coming to the recital.}} {{mask_14}}? Her father has already saved the date.

The lesson is nearly over. {{red:Maya has finished the practice exercise.}} {{mask_15}}? Her teacher writes a few notes in the lesson book. {{red:Maya does understand the final instruction.}} {{mask_16}}? She asks one more question about the rhythm. {{red:The teacher is available next week.}} {{mask_17}}? They look at the studio calendar.

Before leaving, Maya packs her folder. {{red:She has put the recital program in her bag.}} {{mask_18}}? She checks the side pocket. {{red:Her music is safe inside the folder.}} {{mask_19}}? Maya closes it carefully. {{red:The lesson is over for today.}} {{mask_20}}? They say goodbye and agree to practice again next week.
